name: ww-api
description: HERE API proxy for Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --outdir dist --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && pnpm run sentry:sourcemaps
scripts.deploy:dev: wrangler deploy --env dev --outdir dist --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && pnpm run sentry:sourcemaps
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: sentry-cli releases new $(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) --strip-prefix 'dist/..' dist
